title: The Art of Being
author: Erich Fromm
description: This never before published volume supplements one of Fromm's most popular works, To Have or to Be. Fromm examines the true paths--as opposed to false directions--that will lead us to self-knowledge and enlightenment and offers another way to self-awareness and well-being, one based on psychoanalysis and self-awareness…
